## What

The strip across the top of every page of the demo store (`components/demo-notes.tsx`, `DemoStrip`), "Stripe test mode: no real money moves. Pay with 4242 4242 4242 4242...", sat outside every landmark. axe-core flagged `region` on the store, each of its products, its booking page, its blog and /demo. A screen reader user who moves by landmarks skipped the one notice that no real money is charged.

Fix: the strip is wrapped in `<aside aria-label="Demo store">`. Its words, look and place are unchanged (screenshot checked at 390 px).

## Proof

- RED first: `tests/demo-strip-landmark.test.ts` (2 of 2 failing before).
- Browser after (real build): no axe finding on /@harborkitchen, the Weekly Meal Planner product and the blog at 320 and 1280 px, forced colors and 400% zoom.
- Related tests pass: `demo-store`, `store-layout-language`, `store-layout-skip-link`, `task-layout-skip-links`, `checkout-branding`, `accessibility-inventory`, `reveal-*`, `site-metadata-opening`, `store-font`.

## Acessibilidade

- **Criteria checked:** axe `region` (best practice supporting 1.3.1 Info and Relationships and 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks); every WCAG 2.2 A/AA/AAA rule axe runs.
- **Method:** axe-core 4.13 on the rendered pages; the landmark list read from the markup.
- **Result:** 1 `region` node on every demo page → 0.
- **Steps and decisions of the main task:** 0 → 0.
- **Not covered:** how NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver and TalkBack announce the new landmark was not heard; no people.
---
Method shared by every unit of this audit: `next start` of a local production build of main (2f967c03 / 7b04206e) with this change, the stand-ins of `tests/e2e/services.mjs` and the synthetic stores of `tests/e2e/store-front-seed.ts`; Chromium 153 through Playwright; axe-core 4.13 (`wcag2a`…`wcag22aaa`, `best-practice`); real Tab presses; characters counted on each rendered line; colours computed in the page. ## What

The site's footer (`components/site-footer.tsx`, on /pricing, the 404 page and the other pages that use the full footer) drew each column link as a 44 px box, but `-my-2.5` under `space-y-1.5` laid the boxes 30 px apart: the next link covered the bottom of each one. Measured with `elementFromPoint`, about **25 links took a click on only 30 px of height**, at 320 and 1280 px. "Cooks" and "Blog" were also **43 and 31 px wide**.

Fix: every column and bottom-row link is `min-h-11 min-w-11` with no negative margin, so the boxes sit end to end; the slim footer's links get `min-w-11`. The columns are taller (44 px a link instead of 30). The support address stays a link inside its sentence, which 2.5.5 exempts.

## Proof

- RED first: `tests/site-footer-targets.test.ts` (2 of 2 failing before), over the full, home and morning variants.
- Browser after (real build): 44 px of height take the click on every footer link of /pricing, the 404 page and / (one boundary pixel row between two touching links is rounded to the next one; the boxes do not overlap).
- Related tests pass: `tap-targets`, `home-footer`, `home-modules`, `pricing-page`, `security-page`, `status-page`, `accessibility-statement`, `store-front-accessibility`.

## Acessibilidade

- **Criteria checked:** 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced), AAA; 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), AA, already passed by spacing.
- **Method:** each link scrolled into view; the rows and columns of its box where `elementFromPoint` returns the link itself.
- **Result:** effective height 30 → 44 px; width of short links 31–43 → 44 px.
- **Steps and decisions of the main task:** 0 → 0.
- **Not covered:** the 404 page also has an axe `region` finding (the preview bar and the logo link outside a landmark) in `components/site-nav.tsx`, and the header's six controls are 40 px tall; not changed here because #3663 changes those lines. No screen reader, no people.
---

## What

A text field's 1 px border is its only outline, and it measured **1.74:1** on a store (the list's email, a gift's fields, the number of people, the purchases and waitlist pages) and **1.72:1** on the site (`/signin`, `/library`). 1.4.11 (AA) asks for 3:1.

- Stores: a new `fieldEdge` in `lookColours` and `--st-field-edge` in `lookStyle` (`lib/store-look.ts`): the strong line moved towards the page's text until it keeps 3:1 against the field and the page, card and item around it. Light and Bold 3.21–3.36:1, Sand 3.13–3.61:1, Night 3.05–3.59:1; a creator's colour does not move it. `.st-field` draws its border with it.
- Site: `.field` draws its border with the existing control-edge token `--line-off` (#857f70): 3.99:1 on white, 3.38:1 on sand. Hover (`--ink-mute`) and focus (`--violet` + ring) are unchanged.

Buttons are not changed: their words identify them (1.4.11 does not ask a labelled button for a 3:1 boundary).

## Proof

- RED first: `tests/field-edge-contrast.test.ts` (3 of 4 failing before).
- Browser after (real build): no text field under 3:1 on the product, store, sign-in, library, purchases and waitlist pages.
- All 48 `tests/*.test.ts` files that read `lib/store-look.ts`, `lookStyle`, `lookColours` or `app/globals.css` pass.

## Acessibilidade

- **Criteria checked:** 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast, AA.
- **Method:** in the page, each field's border colour blended over the colour behind it, against the field's fill and the surface around it.
- **Result:** 1.74:1 / 1.72:1 → at least 3.05:1 in every theme.
- **Steps and decisions of the main task:** 0 → 0.
- **Not covered:** the dark site palette staged in #3548/#3557 (it maps `--line-off` itself); checkboxes and radios are native and were not measured; no screen reader, no people.

**Claude 3 (nuvem D), revisão independente com execução do #3748 no head exato `5f9a6c83cc99cc59f1786a19449e35ad0ec2a05c`, 2ª revisão. Pode entrar, sem achado.** Só comentário.

**O que conferi**
- **Loja:** `fieldEdge` aproxima a linha forte do texto da página (`nearestPassing`) até chegar a 3:1 contra o campo, o cartão, o item e o fundo. Se nenhum degrau passa, devolve o próprio texto, que já é ≥ 7:1 contra essas superfícies.
- **`--st-field-edge`** vem de `lookStyle`, a mesma origem de `--st-line-strong`. O único lugar que redefine as variáveis da loja sem `lookStyle` é o bloco de impressão do certificado (`.cert-sheet`), que não tem campos. Portanto, nenhum `.st-field` fica sem borda.
- **Site:** `.field` passa de `--line-strong` (`#cbc5b8`) para `--line-off` (`#857f70`).
- **Estados:** nenhum volta a borda a uma cor mais clara.
  - Site: `:hover` vai a `--ink-mute`, `:focus` a `--violet`, `aria-invalid` a `--danger`, desligado a `--line-off` tracejado, e o alto contraste usa `GrayText`.
